facts.value: European Studies at the University of Limerick is a broad and integrated world-class programme that allows students an in-depth opportunity to study European languages and policy, equipping them with highly sought-after digital and research skills.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

facts.value: It is the only European Studies programme in Ireland which includes Irish as one of its language options.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

facts.value: Brexit means more direct interaction with the EU and with individual member states on the continent, creating a greater need for knowledge of the European Union and Ireland’s place within it.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

facts.value: The programme develops knowledge and understanding of historical origins, economic, legal and societal aspects, and political institutions of Europe.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

facts.value: The programme links knowledge of the cultures and languages of key member states.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

facts.value: The University of Limerick has long led the way in Ireland in the field of European Studies, resulting in this degree being one of the longest established European Studies degree programmes in Europe.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

facts.value: UL has the largest outgoing cohort in Ireland with approx. 500 UL students studying abroad at European partner institutions each year.
